review_evidence: KLR/Core/Operators.lean defines operator/data-pattern inductives and structures with dependency/target semantics; KLR/K/K1-K3 define ASTs, interpreters, and compilation passes.
KLR/Semantics/Memory.lean, SmallStep.lean, Logic.lean, ProofRules.lean, NKI.lean, and KLR.lean provide an explicit formal semantics and reasoning layer.
The NKI, TGR, Trace, Serde, Core, Py, and Extract hierarchies contain reusable specifications and transformations, not merely build or CLI wrappers.
summary: Retain KLR because it formalizes compiler IRs, language semantics, operator models, traces, serialization, compilation passes, and proof rules.
